news.headline: Lilly Owes Nektar Nearly $1 Billion If It Breached Rezpeg Deal, Damages Expert Tells Jury
news.summary: On the third day of the San Francisco federal jury trial, Nektar's damages expert testified that Eli Lilly could owe the company close to $1 billion in lost milestone and royalty payments if jurors find Lilly breached the 2017 rezpegaldesleukin collaboration agreement. The testimony followed Tuesday's ruling admitting Nektar's financial condition into evidence, with no verdict yet reached as witness testimony continues in the breach-of-contract trial (N.D. Cal. 3:23-cv-03943).

news.headline: Nektar Fails to Block Financial-Condition Evidence After CEO's Cross-Examination in Eli Lilly Trial
news.summary: On the second day of the San Francisco federal jury trial, Nektar's bid to keep evidence of its financial condition out of the case was denied after CEO Howard Robin's cross-examination testimony prompted the judge to admit it for impeachment purposes. The ruling is a procedural setback that could let Eli Lilly frame Nektar's damages claims against its cash position and losses, with no verdict yet reached as the breach-of-contract trial over the terminated rezpegaldesleukin collaboration continues.

news.headline: Eli Lilly 'Sabotaged' Rezpeg's Development, Nektar Tells Jury as Breach-of-Contract Trial Opens
news.summary: The long-delayed jury trial over the terminated rezpegaldesleukin collaboration opened with opening statements before an 8-person federal jury in San Francisco, after being pushed back from an original October 2025 date. Nektar's counsel told jurors Lilly breached the 2017 deal and favored a competing internal program, mishandling the ISLAND lupus trial and miscalculating REZOLVE-AD/psoriasis results shown at EADV 2022; Lilly's counsel countered Nektar was unharmed by the deal's termination, with only Nektar's claims reaching the jury after its counterclaims were dismissed.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD Results for Rezpegaldesleukin in Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published the full 16-week induction dataset from the 393-patient REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b study across 107 sites in 10 countries: mean EASI reductions of 61%, 58% and 53% across dose arms versus 31% for placebo (p<0.0001), with EASI-75 at 42% versus 17% and significant separation as early as Week 2. Serious adverse events occurred in only 2% of participants with no deaths and no infection or conjunctivitis signal, the first peer-reviewed validation of the Treg-expansion mechanism in a clinically meaningful skin endpoint.

news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 target, a cautious voice alongside Wedbush's reduced target after Q2 earnings, sitting well below Canaccord Genuity's Buy-rated $153 target (initiated July 22) and Piper Sandler's Overweight, near-$190 target. The spread illustrates a wide analyst split ahead of the mid-2028 Phase 3 readout.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by a $373.8 million April equity raise, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss was $40.6 million ($1.23 per share) on revenue of $10.1 million, and management reaffirmed a ZENITH AD-3 start in September, a new autoimmune-indication study before year-end 2026, a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027, and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial (N.D. Cal., San Francisco)
catalysts.detail: Trial opened September 8, 2026 before an 8-person jury. On September 9 the judge admitted evidence of Nektar's financial condition after CEO Howard Robin's cross-examination opened the door to it for impeachment purposes, and on September 10 Nektar's damages expert testified Lilly could owe nearly $1 billion in lost milestones and royalties if breach is found. Lilly denies wrongdoing; no verdict reported as of September 12 as testimony and deliberations continue. This remains a binary, clinically-uncorrelated financial wildcard for the stock.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin by late September 2026 after the July starts of ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2. It completes the roughly 1,530-patient registrational package for U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in patients who already failed Dupixent or a JAK. Management reaffirmed the September timing on the August 13 Q2 call; no separate start announcement has been issued yet.

catalysts.label: Two oral presentations at the 35th EADV Congress, Vienna
catalysts.detail: Nektar has two accepted oral presentations at EADV 2026: Thomas Bieber on durable, deepening improvements with monthly and quarterly maintenance dosing from REZOLVE-AD, and David Rosmarin (abstract AS-1872, Oct 1, 16:30-16:40 CEST) on 52-week Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA results in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Maintenance durability at reduced dosing frequency is the main commercial differentiator versus Dupixent, so dermatology-community reception matters as much as the topline numbers.

catalysts.label: 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata topline (REZOLVE-AA)
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to report topline data from the 24-week off-treatment period of REZOLVE-AA in Q4 2026, to inform long-term maintenance dosing ahead of the Phase 3 start. Durability off drug is the key differentiator versus chronically dosed JAK inhibitors like Litfulo and Olumiant. Exact date and venue have not been named.

catalysts.label: Start of a clinical study in an additional autoimmune indication
catalysts.detail: Management committed on the Q2 call to initiating a new clinical study in a further autoimmune indication before year-end 2026, to broaden the Treg mechanism beyond atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata and type 1 diabetes. The indication has not been disclosed; a February 2026 research collaboration with UCSF (Dr. Stephen Hauser) in multiple sclerosis is the most-cited speculation.

catalysts.label: First NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist) preclinical data at a scientific conference
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to presenting preclinical data for NKTR-0165, its bivalent TNFR2 agonist antibody, at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026. It is the most meaningful pipeline asset behind rezpeg and is paired with the February 2026 UCSF multiple sclerosis collaboration. Venue and date are not yet named, so slippage into 2027 is possible.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start with enrollment color across all three Phase 3 AD studies, and address the financial and strategic consequences of the September Eli Lilly jury trial outcome. Zacks raised its Q3 loss estimate to a narrower ($2.70) per share on September 3, 2026, from ($2.92) previously. Exact date not yet announced; Nektar has reported Q3 in early-to-mid November in prior years.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data
catalysts.detail: Management guided to present 52-week off-treatment data for atopic dermatitis in Q1 2027 to further inform long-term maintenance dosing while the ZENITH AD Phase 3s enroll, building on earlier signals of roughly nine months of off-treatment durability.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start (~850 patients)
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, sized at roughly 850 patients, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept (28.2% mean SALT reduction vs 11.2% placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg holds FDA Fast Track in this indication; readout guided to second-half 2029.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 2 type 1 diabetes data (TrialNet collaboration)
catalysts.detail: Nektar guided to initial 2027 data from the TrialNet-run Phase 2 randomized, placebo-controlled study of rezpegaldesleukin in roughly 70 adults and children with new-onset stage 3 type 1 diabetes. Nektar supplies drug and TrialNet funds and runs the trial, so cost to Nektar is minimal while optionality is large.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout (mid-2028)
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis is the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway extends into Q3 2028, so the company reaches this readout without needing another raise. Replicating the Phase 2b 61%-vs-31% mean EASI delta at Phase 3 scale is essentially what the roughly $150+ consensus target discounts.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Nektar has guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029 following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The Phase 3 program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European marketing authorisation application is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Shares have slipped to around $70-71 (market cap roughly $2.4 billion), off their pre-trial levels, with the tape still driven mainly by legal-event positioning: the Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial over the terminated rezpeg collaboration remains ongoing in San Francisco federal court, with no verdict yet reported as of September 12 after Nektar's damages expert told the jury on September 10 that Lilly could owe close to $1 billion if breach is found. Analyst sentiment stays split but net constructive (a 'Moderate Buy'/'Strong Buy' mix, including a TD Cowen upgrade to Strong Buy on August 24), spanning JPMorgan's cautious $65 target to Piper Sandler's bullish target near $190, while the genuine business catalyst underpinning the bull case remains the August 25 Lancet publication of the full REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b dataset (61% vs 31% mean EASI reduction) validating the Treg mechanism. With about $1.02 billion in cash funding runway into Q3 2028, the near-term sequence is the Lilly trial outcome, the ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 start by late September, two EADV oral presentations in Vienna (Sept 30-Oct 3) on maintenance-dosing durability, and a Q4 alopecia off-treatment topline, ahead of the pivotal mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout.
